stories.title: Switzerland says Italy is not taking back asylum seekers

en.title: Switzerland says Italy is not taking back asylum seekers
en.summary: Switzerland announced plans to resume returning asylum seekers to Italy under the Dublin Regulation in late August, but Italy has not accepted any returns so far, according to Swiss Justice Minister Beat Jans. Italy is allegedly failing to comply with European common rules on these transfers.

stories.title: Au départ de Genève, on préfère désormais voler vers la Chine plutôt que vers les Etats-Unis

en.title: From Geneva, passengers now prefer flying to China rather than the United States
en.summary: Geneva airport recorded more passenger traffic to and from China than to and from the United States for the first time in its history during July and August. The shift reflects both increased flight availability and changing travel preferences.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce avoir obtenu un accord sur la sécurité du Groenland

en.title: Donald Trump announces he has obtained an agreement on Greenland security
en.summary: Donald Trump announced securing permanent security control over Greenland with Denmark and Greenland, allowing the United States to prevent rival military installations or sensitive investments there. The deal preserves Danish sovereignty after Trump previously threatened annexation.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce avoir obtenu avec le Danemark un accord sur la sécurité du Groenland

en.title: Donald Trump announces he has obtained an agreement with Denmark on Greenland security
en.summary: Donald Trump announced securing permanent security control over Greenland with Denmark and Greenland, preventing potential adversary military or strategic presence. This followed earlier statements by Trump about potentially annexing the Arctic territory.
